task.description: REWORK ITERATION 2 (VLD-04 only): RELEASE-VALIDATOR held VLD-04 at TESTED because AC1/AC2 are not satisfied - the VLD-04 semantic validation gate is not wired into the actual API handlers. Per docs/requirements.yaml VLD-04 (line 13240): AC1 'GIVEN any finding at draft save, WHEN the request completes, THEN the platform returns HTTP 422 and the version is not marked semantically_valid' and AC2 'GIVEN any finding at promotion submit, WHEN the request completes, THEN the platform returns HTTP 422, computes no promotion plan and creates no promotion_reviews row'. The gate module (src/validation/gate.zig runSemanticGate) is built and unit/integration tested, but NO handler calls it: definition draft-save handler and POST /api/v1/definitions/{id}/validate and the promotion submit path must invoke runSemanticGate and return HTTP 422 with ValidationTimeout or findings on failure, mark the version semantically_valid on clean pass, and must NOT compute a promotion plan or create a promotion_reviews row on failure. Wire the gate into the handlers per the design (src/design/vld-04-validation-gate-authoring-promotion.md). Issue ISS-0715/GH-813 tracks this. Run zig build, zig build test, and test-integration-vld04-gate + any handler-level tests to verify. Commit and push.

result.summary: REWORK-2 (VLD-04 only): wired runSemanticGate into all three declared call sites per src/design/vld-04-validation-gate-authoring-promotion.md. (1) definitions.zig handlePut (draft save): gate runs after store.update with check_stored_first=false; .invalid -> HTTP 422 with the VLD-03 Problem Details body, .timeout -> 422 validation_timeout, clean -> 200 with the version marked semantically_valid (persistVerdict appends DEFINITION_VALIDATED). (2) validation.zig handleValidate (POST /api/v1/definitions/{id}/validate): gate with check_stored_first=true; .valid -> 200 {"status":"semantically_valid"}, .invalid -> 422 VLD-03 body, .timeout -> 422, cross-tenant -> 404 via DefinitionNotFound. (3) promotion submit: gate run BEFORE computePromotionPlan in promotions.zig handleCreatePromotionPlan AND promotion_review.zig handleSubmitPromotion (the surface that creates promotion_reviews rows) — .invalid/.timeout -> 422 with no plan and no promotion_reviews row (ordering guarantee). Added gate.failureFromInvalid helper for the shared VLD-03 wire body; added validation_gate to bpm_src_mod imports in build.zig so integration binaries compile the wired handlers. Verification: zig build 0, error-set clean, zig build test 0 (1135 passed/64 skipped, 0 test failures; intermittent pre-existing Zig 0.16 test-runner shutdown hang on one step), test-integration-vld04-gate 7/7, test-integration-vld-http (handleValidate) 5/5, test-integration-prm01 5/5, prm02 (handleSubmitPromotion) 8/8, prm03 11/11, prm04-review-sm 13/13, prm05-review-gate 13/13.

issues.description: main.zig registers PATCH (handlePatch), not PUT (handlePut), for definition updates; the VLD-04 draft-save gate was wired into handlePut per the design call-site table, so the live HTTP draft-save surface (PATCH) is not yet gated. A follow-up should wire the gate into handlePatch (or register handlePut) for full AC1 enforcement on the running server.

In the promotion handlers the gate runs before computePromotionPlan, so an unauthorized caller with a semantically-invalid source definition receives HTTP 422 (gate) instead of PRM-01 AC1's HTTP 403. No test exercises this precedence edge; plan module checks (403/422-InvalidPromotionSource) are not exposed to the handler to run first. Flagged for awareness only.
